decision.rationale: Both prompt conditions completed reliably and cheaply, but both failed the prospective 0.95 citation-correctness floor after support review. P1 also induced more unsupported elaboration and unnecessary tutoring moves, so neither prompt can advance to held-out.
limitations: The development corpus is deliberately synthetic and repetitive.
The support review is Codex-assisted single review rather than independent human review.
Three deterministic analysis rules were found over-strict and corrected prospectively without rerunning provider output.
The 104-case held-out split remains unopened and no final generator or prompt is selected.
